'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Siege of Gaza City]]
****At least fifteen [[Palestinian]]s are killed and 29 others are injured in an [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli]] strike on a school in the [[Shuja'iyya]] neighborhood of [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/least-10-palestinians-killed-israeli-strike-school-gaza-emergency-services-say-2024-08-01/ (Reuters)]
**[[Israel]] claims to have verified that it killed [[Hamas]] military commander [[Mohammed Deif]] in an [[13 July 2024 al-Mawasi attack|attack on al-Mawasi on July 13]]. Hamas denies the allegations. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/08/01/hamas-commander-mohammed-deif-killed/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Iran–Israel proxy conflict]]
**[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Hezbollah–Israel conflict|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
***Hezbollah fires dozens of [[Katyusha rocket launcher|Katyusha rockets]] at northern Israel.[https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/israel-hamas-war-live-updates-beirut-hezbollah-ismail-haniyeh-benjamin-netanyahu-gaza-war/liveblog/112183724.cms (The Times of India)]
'''Business and economy'''
*[[Intel]] announces plans to lay off 15% of its workforce in order to reduce its operating costs. [https://apnews.com/article/intel-chip-ai-job-cuts-layoffs-loss-e61781e9364b69af63481c34ca5dcd67 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Typhoon Gaemi]]
***[[South Korea]] reports that as many as 1,500 people may have been killed by floods in [[North Korea]] caused by the remnants of Typhoon Gaemi. [https://www.terradaily.com/reports/N_Korea_floods_may_have_caused_heavy_casualties_Seoul_999.html (Terra Daily)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/7/30/dozens-dead-as-tail-end-of-typhoon-gaemi-lashes-china (Al Jazeera)] 
*[[2024 India–Bangladesh floods]]
**At least 12 people are killed and more than 250 people are declared missing after heavy downpours and flooding in [[North India|northern India]], with rainfall amounts of up to {{conv|183|mm|in}} reported in some areas. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/least-two-dead-indias-capital-schools-shut-after-heavy-rain-2024-08-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Wayanad landslides]]
**The death toll from the [[landslide]]s caused by torrential rains in [[Kerala]], [[India]], increases to 296 people, with at least 240 others still missing. [https://www.onmanorama.com/news/kerala/2024/08/01/wayanad-landslide-death-toll-missing-mundakkai-chooralmala-live.html (Onomanorama)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[2024 Sudan famine]]
***The Global Famine Review Committee declares a [[famine]] in [[Darfur]], [[Sudan]], according to the [[Integrated Food Security Phase Classification]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/global-food-monitor-says-famine-has-taken-hold-sudans-darfur-2024-08-01/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2024 Russian prisoner exchange]], [[Germany–Russia relations]], [[Russia–United States relations]]
**[[Russia]] and several Western nations, including [[Germany]] and the [[United States]], conduct a major [[prisoner exchange]] mediated by [[Turkey]], with ten prisoners being transferred to Russia, thirteen to [[Germany]], and three to the United States. Journalist [[Evan Gershkovich]], former marine [[Paul Whelan (security director)|Paul Whelan]], and Russian opposition figure [[Vladimir Kara-Murza]] are among those freed. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-gershkovich-whelan-d803e266cb4e60135ec5d668d684529f (AP)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/1/us-russia-swap-prisoner-in-extensive-deal (Al Jazeera)]
*[[China–India relations]]
**[[China]] and [[India]] conduct a 30th round of talks in [[New Delhi]], [[India]], to resolve their ongoing [[Sino-Indian border dispute|border disputes]], agreeing to speed up negotiations over the disputes and to maintain peace and tranquility in border regions. [https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3272777/30th-round-talks-border-dispute-china-and-india-agree-speed-negotiations (''South China Morning Post'')]
*[[Moldova–Russia relations]]
**The [[Government of Moldova|Moldovan government]] expels a [[Russia]]n diplomat from the country over alleged [[espionage]]. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2024/08/01/moldova-expels-russian-diplomat-over-espionage-claims-a85900 (''The Moscow Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2009 Guinean protests]]
**A criminal court in [[Guinea]] sentences former [[President of Guinea|president]] and [[Republic of Guinea Armed Forces|military]] leader [[Moussa Dadis Camara]] to 20 years in prison for [[crimes against humanity]] while suppressing an opposition rally in [[Conakry]] in 2009. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/1/guinea-court-jails-ex-military-leader-camara-for-crimes-against-humanity (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2024 United Kingdom riots]]
**[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|UK Prime Minister]] [[Keir Starmer]] addresses the nation following civil unrest in [[Southport]], [[Hartlepool]], and [[Whitehall]], accusing the "[[Far-right politics in the United Kingdom|far-right]]" of being behind the violence. Starmer also warns [[social media]] platforms to crackdown on [[misinformation]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/article/2024/aug/01/far-right-riots-keir-starmer-announce-new-violent-disorder-unit (''The Guardian'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[End Bad Governance protests]]
**Fourteen protestors are killed, four are injured and at least 31 are arrested, including a journalist, during nationwide protests that turned violent in [[Nigeria]] amid a [[cost-of-living crisis]], which protestors blame on [[President of Nigeria|President]] [[Bola Tinubu]]'s new reforms. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/1/hundreds-protest-across-nigeria-over-soaring-cost-of-living-fuel-prices (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russia]] withdraws from the [[Framework Convention for the Protection of National Minorities]], originally established by the [[Council of Europe]] in 1995. [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2024/08/14/7470409/ (''Ukrainska Pravda'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024 Summer Olympics]]
**[[Swimming at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***American swimmer [[Katie Ledecky]] wins her 13th [[Olympic medal]] in [[Swimming at the Summer Olympics|swimming]], becoming the first American female to do so and the second American to do so after [[Michael Phelps]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/interactive/2024/07/31/sports/olympics/katie-ledecky-us-olympics-swimming.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[Tennis at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***[[Novak Djokovic]] defeats [[Stefanos Tsitsipas]] to advance to the semifinals of the [[Tennis at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Men's singles|Men's singles tournament]], becoming the only player to reach the semifinals four times, and the oldest semifinalist in [[Tennis at the Summer Olympics|Olympic tennis history]]. [https://www.si.com/betting/olympic-tennis-odds-novak-djokovic-vs-lorenzo-musetti-prediction-for-semifinal-match-01j47sbbm5nn (''Sports Illustrated'')]
